description: This file defines an abstract base class 'EntityDisplayBase' for managing entity display configurations in Drupal, including methods for initialization, dependency management, component handling, and serialization.

classes.name: EntityDisplayBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for entity display configurations, including component management, dependency handling, and serialization in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the display with configuration values and entity type, setting up renderer, plugin manager, and display context.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes default display options for components and fields based on context and configuration.

methods.name: getTargetEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the target entity type ID.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the current display mode.

methods.name: getOriginalMode
methods.description: Returns the original requested display mode.

methods.name: getTargetBundle
methods.description: Returns the target bundle.

methods.name: setTargetBundle
methods.description: Sets the target bundle.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for the display based on entity type, bundle, and mode.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Prepares the display entity for saving, ensuring regions are set on components.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates dependencies for the display, including bundle, fields, and modes.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the display configuration to an array, excluding non-configurable fields.

methods.name: createCopy
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the display with a new mode.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Returns all components of the display.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns a specific component by name.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Adds or updates a component with specified options.

methods.name: removeComponent
methods.description: Hides a component by name.

methods.name: getHighestWeight
methods.description: Returns the highest weight among components for ordering.

methods.name: getFieldDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the field definition for a given field name.

methods.name: getFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves all field definitions eligible for display.

methods.name: fieldHasDisplayOptions
methods.description: Checks if a field has display options for the current context.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles removal of dependencies, updating components accordingly.

methods.name: getPluginRemovedDependencies
methods.description: Computes intersection of plugin dependencies and removed dependencies.

methods.name: getDefaultRegion
methods.description: Returns the default region for display components.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Serializes the object, storing only necessary data.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Restores object state after unserialization.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Provides the system logger service.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property value, updating related entity type info if ID changes.
